description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI' used to check for punch-in record overlaps during editing in the OrangeHRM attendance module. It includes methods for retrieving input parameters, validating them, and verifying whether a punch-in record overlaps with existing records.

classes.description: API endpoint class for checking punch-in overlap during editing in the attendance module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to check if a punch-in record overlaps during editing. Validates record ID, retrieves the record, checks access, and determines overlap based on UTC times.

methods.description: Parses input date, time, and timezone offsets to produce corresponding UTC DateTime objects for punch-in and punch-out times.
